dimensions.assessment: Affects the Keweenaw Bay Indian Community members, local non-Indian property owners within the L'Anse Indian Reservation, and federal/state agencies.
dimensions.evidence: transfer $33,900,000 to the Community... the title of all current owners to the Reservation Swamp Lands and the Reservation Canal Lands is cleared

dimensions.assessment: Provides millions in financial compensation, permanently resolves land claims, and clears property titles for residents.
dimensions.evidence: to provide compensation to the Keweenaw Bay Indian Community for the taking without just compensation of land

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes an appropriation of $33,900,000 for fiscal year 2026 to be transferred to the Community.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out subsection (a) $33,900,000 for fiscal year 2026

dimensions.assessment: Settles specific historical land claims, authorizes fund transfers, and legally extinguishes title claims within a specific reservation.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Department of the Interior to transfer funds to the Keweenaw Bay Indian Community... in order to settle the KBIC's land claims and clear title

dimensions.assessment: One-time financial transfer with permanent legal effect on property titles and claim extinguishments.

missing_information: Exact number of individual non-Indian landowners whose titles are cleared
Long-term economic projections for the Community resulting from the settlement
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes a $33.9 million federal appropriation to compensate the Keweenaw Bay Indian Community for historical land takings, extinguishes tribal claims to those lands, and clears titles for current landowners.
